stops.note: literally free booty-taker, the same root behind freebooter
from Dutch 'vrijbuiter', freebooter; William Walker's 1850s raids on Central America were called filibusters
the US Senate sense of obstructing a vote by speaking at length dates from the 1850s
stops.meaning: the use of extreme obstructive tactics in a legislature

current_meaning: the use of prolonged speech or other tactics to obstruct legislative action
